jobs.prompt: Use case: game sprite. A SINGLE connected young story-tree crown pose on a transparent fixed 192 by 176 canvas. Low-isometric whimsical hand-crafted pixel art in moss, forest green, warm lime and muted ochre matching the supplied palette. Place a small dense asymmetrical leafy sprout in the lower middle. Its attachment point is exact bottom-center at pixel 96,160. Build a deliberate fully opaque foliage overlap collar around that attachment point: a connected dark moss-green U-shaped leaf mass spanning about x 78 to 114 and y 142 to 169, with no transparent hole through the middle. The collar is part of the crown and must wrap behind/around a trunk top so the trunk-to-canopy seam is hidden. Above it, a modest irregular budding crown, roughly x 64 to 128 and y 82 to 160. FOLIAGE ONLY. No trunk, no branches, no roots, no island, no ground, no shadow, no detached clusters, no floating leaves, no halo, no text, no border. Keep generous transparent padding and keep the bottom-center collar opaque.
jobs.observedResult: PixFlux returned a whole-tree/island study despite the foliage-only constraint. The upper connected palette-matched crown was retained at author/import time; generated land and wood were excluded.

jobs.prompt: Use case: game sprite. A SINGLE connected mature story-tree crown pose on a transparent fixed 192 by 176 canvas. Low-isometric whimsical hand-crafted pixel art in moss, forest green, warm lime and muted ochre matching the supplied palette. Broad asymmetric umbrella canopy with layered scalloped leaf masses and a few small internal negative spaces, occupying roughly x 14 to 178 and y 8 to 160. Its attachment point is exact bottom-center at pixel 96,160. Build a deliberate fully opaque foliage overlap collar around that attachment point: a connected dark moss-green U-shaped leaf mass spanning about x 72 to 120 and y 138 to 171, with no transparent hole through the middle. The collar must visibly belong to the crown and wrap behind/around a trunk top, hiding the trunk-to-canopy seam from every side. ONE coherent connected crown silhouette, not free-floating clusters. FOLIAGE ONLY. No trunk, no branches, no roots, no island, no ground, no shadow, no detached leaves, no halo, no text, no border. Keep transparent padding and keep the bottom-center collar opaque.
jobs.observedResult: PixFlux returned a coherent full-tree study despite the foliage-only constraint. The upper connected palette-matched mature crown was retained and registered; generated wood was excluded.

jobs.action: A planted story-tree crown sprouts organically from the fixed bottom-center crown socket into the mature broad canopy. Redraw the connected foliage silhouette pose by pose with asymmetric budding and outward leaf growth. Keep the exact 192x176 canvas, transparent background, fixed crown socket at pixel 96,160, and the dark opaque overlap collar around x72..120 y140..170 attached in every frame. The collar does not move, float, fade, separate, or become transparent. One coherent connected crown only: no trunk, no branches, no roots, no island, no ground, no shadow, no detached clusters, no floating leaves, no halo, no camera motion, no whole-crown translation.
